title: HandLive — call notification content (Mac, iPhone, iPad)
description: CALL-01 API 6–7 and CALL-04 API 4: the UNNotificationRequest content of an incoming or a missed call, written as JSON. Not a wire message: it fixes the identifiers, categories and userInfo that M-APP, I-APP and I-NSE share (the Decline and Message actions and the seen marking read userInfo). One of #/$defs/incoming, #/$defs/missed.

title.description: The contact name, else the number in national format, else the catalog text call.no_caller_id or call.unknown_caller.

incoming.description: Incoming call: the iPhone/iPad notification rebuilt by I-NSE (API 6) or the Mac communication notification (identifier = call_id, API 7). The category is set only when the notification offers its actions, so content without buttons has none and keeps its passive or timeSensitive level. A push that arrives more than 60 s after started_at (CALL-01 E7) is shown late: body call.incoming_late, no category, level active — the only incoming content at the active level. Only the Mac time-sensitive variant (a Focus hides the panel) sets a sound, the default one. A locked iPhone keeps the push's own generic content and is not described here (E6).

identifier.description: Mac: the call_id, one notification per call, posted again to update it; a notification created by a push has an identifier set by the system.

body.description: call.incoming_body, call.incoming_body_sim with the SIM label, or call.incoming_late (E7).

categoryIdentifier.description: HL_CALL_INCOMING (iOS: action HL_CALL_REJECT), set when controls.reject is true; HL_CALL_INCOMING_MAC (actions HL_CALL_ANSWER, HL_CALL_REJECT), set when controls.answer and controls.reject are both true. Absent otherwise, and for a late push (E7).

interruptionLevel.description: passive while the Mac panel shows; timeSensitive on iPhone/iPad (from the APNs interruption-level) and on the Mac while a Focus hides the panel; active for a late push (E7).

sound.description: The Mac time-sensitive variant only (API 7): that level alone is silent on macOS. The passive Mac notification sets none, and iPhone/iPad content sets none: its push already carries the default sound (CONN-04 API 4).

userInfo.description: Read by the Decline action (CALL-02 B2).

allOf.description: Only the late push (E7) is at the active level; it is rebuilt by I-NSE on iPhone/iPad, so it has no category and no identifier of its own.
Only the Mac notification at the time-sensitive level carries a sound (API 7). The Mac is told by its identifier (call_id) or its category, which is never the iPhone one.

missed.description: Missed call (CALL-04 API 4), from a call_event/log_new with type = missed, or from a call_event/state with end_reason = missed when the phone lacks READ_CALL_LOG (flow A). Category HL_CALL_MISSED only when the number is known and the phone can send SMS (E10); a locked iPhone keeps the push's own generic content (E9).

identifier.description: call-missed:<pair_id>:<entry_id>; flow A call-missed:<pair_id>:<call_id>; a notification created by a push has an identifier set by the system.

body.description: call.missed_body, or call.missed_body_sim with the SIM label.

threadIdentifier.description: calls:<pair_id>; a notification created by a push keeps the relay's generic calls.

userInfo.description: Read by the Message action and to mark the entry seen; entry_id is null in flow A, call_id when no context matched; at least one of them is set.
